```{r}
# =========================================================
# LOGISTIC CHANGE-POINT PROJECT: FULL CORRECTED R CODE
# =========================================================

rm(list = ls())

set.seed(123)

# =========================================================
# 1. TRUE PARAMETER VALUES
# =========================================================
n          <- 60
K_true     <- 100
t0_true    <- 25
r1_true    <- 0.22
r2_true    <- 0.06
tau_true   <- 30
sigma_true <- 3

candidate_tau <- 8:(n - 8)

# =========================================================
# 2. MODEL FUNCTIONS
# =========================================================

# No-change logistic mean
logistic_mean_no_cp <- function(t, K, r, t0) {
  K / (1 + exp(-r * (t - t0)))
}

# Change-point logistic mean
logistic_mean_cp <- function(t, K, r1, r2, t0, tau) {
  ifelse(
    t <= tau,
    K / (1 + exp(-r1 * (t - t0))),
    K / (1 + exp(-r2 * (t - t0)))
  )
}

# Negative log-likelihood: no-change model
nll_no_cp <- function(par, t, y) {
  K     <- par[1]
  r     <- par[2]
  t0    <- par[3]
  sigma <- par[4]
  
  if (K <= 0 || r <= 0 || sigma <= 0) return(1e12)
  
  mu <- logistic_mean_no_cp(t, K, r, t0)
  -sum(dnorm(y, mean = mu, sd = sigma, log = TRUE))
}

# Negative log-likelihood: change-point model
nll_cp <- function(par, t, y, tau) {
  K     <- par[1]
  r1    <- par[2]
  r2    <- par[3]
  t0    <- par[4]
  sigma <- par[5]
  
  if (K <= 0 || r1 <= 0 || r2 <= 0 || sigma <= 0) return(1e12)
  
  mu <- logistic_mean_cp(t, K, r1, r2, t0, tau)
  -sum(dnorm(y, mean = mu, sd = sigma, log = TRUE))
}

# =========================================================
# 3. HELPER FUNCTIONS FOR FITTING
# =========================================================

fit_no_change_model <- function(t, y) {
  start_no <- c(
    K = max(y),
    r = 0.1,
    t0 = median(t),
    sigma = sd(y)
  )
  
  fit_no <- try(
    optim(
      par = start_no,
      fn = nll_no_cp,
      t = t,
      y = y,
      method = "L-BFGS-B",
      lower = c(1e-3, 1e-4, min(t), 1e-3),
      upper = c(1e5, 5, max(t), 1e3)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(fit_no, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  
  par_no <- fit_no$par
  names(par_no) <- c("K", "r", "t0", "sigma")
  
  logLik_no <- -fit_no$value
  AIC_no <- 2 * length(par_no) - 2 * logLik_no
  
  mu_hat_no <- logistic_mean_no_cp(
    t  = t,
    K  = par_no["K"],
    r  = par_no["r"],
    t0 = par_no["t0"]
  )
  
  list(
    fit = fit_no,
    par = par_no,
    logLik = logLik_no,
    AIC = AIC_no,
    fitted = mu_hat_no
  )
}

fit_change_point_model <- function(t, y, candidate_tau) {
  cp_profile <- data.frame(
    tau = candidate_tau,
    nll = NA_real_
  )
  
  cp_fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
  
  for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
    tau_i <- candidate_tau[i]
    
    start_cp <- c(
      K = max(y),
      r1 = 0.15,
      r2 = 0.08,
      t0 = median(t),
      sigma = sd(y)
    )
    
    fit_i <- try(
      optim(
        par = start_cp,
        fn = nll_cp,
        t = t,
        y = y,
        tau = tau_i,
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = c(1e-3, 1e-4, 1e-4, min(t), 1e-3),
        upper = c(1e5, 5, 5, max(t), 1e3)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit_i, "try-error")) {
      cp_profile$nll[i] <- fit_i$value
      cp_fits[[i]] <- fit_i
    }
  }
  
  if (all(is.na(cp_profile$nll))) return(NULL)
  
  best_idx <- which.min(cp_profile$nll)
  tau_hat <- cp_profile$tau[best_idx]
  best_fit <- cp_fits[[best_idx]]
  
  if (is.null(best_fit)) return(NULL)
  
  par_cp <- best_fit$par
  names(par_cp) <- c("K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma")
  
  logLik_cp <- -best_fit$value
  AIC_cp <- 2 * (length(par_cp) + 1) - 2 * logLik_cp
  
  mu_hat_cp <- logistic_mean_cp(
    t   = t,
    K   = par_cp["K"],
    r1  = par_cp["r1"],
    r2  = par_cp["r2"],
    t0  = par_cp["t0"],
    tau = tau_hat
  )
  
  list(
    tau_hat = tau_hat,
    par = par_cp,
    fit = best_fit,
    logLik = logLik_cp,
    AIC = AIC_cp,
    fitted = mu_hat_cp,
    profile = cp_profile
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 4. SIMULATION STUDY
# =========================================================

nsim <- 100

sim_results <- data.frame(
  sim = 1:nsim,
  K_hat_no = NA_real_,
  r_hat_no = NA_real_,
  t0_hat_no = NA_real_,
  sigma_hat_no = NA_real_,
  logLik_no = NA_real_,
  AIC_no = NA_real_,
  
  tau_hat = NA_real_,
  K_hat_cp = NA_real_,
  r1_hat_cp = NA_real_,
  r2_hat_cp = NA_real_,
  t0_hat_cp = NA_real_,
  sigma_hat_cp = NA_real_,
  logLik_cp = NA_real_,
  AIC_cp = NA_real_,
  
  tau_correct = NA,
  cp_better_AIC = NA
)

for (s in 1:nsim) {
  t <- 1:n
  
  mu_true <- ifelse(
    t <= tau_true,
    K_true / (1 + exp(-r1_true * (t - t0_true))),
    K_true / (1 + exp(-r2_true * (t - t0_true)))
  )
  
  y <- mu_true + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma_true)
  
  fit_no <- fit_no_change_model(t, y)
  fit_cp <- fit_change_point_model(t, y, candidate_tau)
  
  if (!is.null(fit_no)) {
    sim_results$K_hat_no[s]     <- fit_no$par["K"]
    sim_results$r_hat_no[s]     <- fit_no$par["r"]
    sim_results$t0_hat_no[s]    <- fit_no$par["t0"]
    sim_results$sigma_hat_no[s] <- fit_no$par["sigma"]
    sim_results$logLik_no[s]    <- fit_no$logLik
    sim_results$AIC_no[s]       <- fit_no$AIC
  }
  
  if (!is.null(fit_cp)) {
    sim_results$tau_hat[s]       <- fit_cp$tau_hat
    sim_results$K_hat_cp[s]      <- fit_cp$par["K"]
    sim_results$r1_hat_cp[s]     <- fit_cp$par["r1"]
    sim_results$r2_hat_cp[s]     <- fit_cp$par["r2"]
    sim_results$t0_hat_cp[s]     <- fit_cp$par["t0"]
    sim_results$sigma_hat_cp[s]  <- fit_cp$par["sigma"]
    sim_results$logLik_cp[s]     <- fit_cp$logLik
    sim_results$AIC_cp[s]        <- fit_cp$AIC
    
    sim_results$tau_correct[s]   <- abs(fit_cp$tau_hat - tau_true) <= 2
    
    if (!is.null(fit_no) && !is.na(fit_no$AIC)) {
      sim_results$cp_better_AIC[s] <- fit_cp$AIC < fit_no$AIC
    }
  }
  
  if (s %% 10 == 0) {
    cat("Finished simulation", s, "of", nsim, "\n")
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# Simulation summary
# -----------------------------
valid <- complete.cases(sim_results[, c(
  "tau_hat", "K_hat_cp", "r1_hat_cp", "r2_hat_cp", "t0_hat_cp", "sigma_hat_cp"
)])
res <- sim_results[valid, ]

summary_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "tau"),
  True = c(K_true, r1_true, r2_true, t0_true, tau_true),
  Mean_Estimate = c(
    mean(res$K_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(res$r1_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(res$r2_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(res$t0_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(res$tau_hat, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Bias = c(
    mean(res$K_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE) - K_true,
    mean(res$r1_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE) - r1_true,
    mean(res$r2_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE) - r2_true,
    mean(res$t0_hat_cp, na.rm = TRUE) - t0_true,
    mean(res$tau_hat, na.rm = TRUE) - tau_true
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean((res$K_hat_cp - K_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sqrt(mean((res$r1_hat_cp - r1_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sqrt(mean((res$r2_hat_cp - r2_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sqrt(mean((res$t0_hat_cp - t0_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sqrt(mean((res$tau_hat - tau_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
)

cat("\n================ SIMULATION SUMMARY ================\n")
print(summary_table)

cat("\nProportion tau estimated within ±2 of truth: ",
    mean(res$tau_correct, na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")

cat("Proportion CP model better by AIC: ",
    mean(res$cp_better_AIC, na.rm = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")

# -----------------------------
# Simulation plots
# -----------------------------
hist(res$tau_hat,
     breaks = 20,
     main = expression("Distribution of " * hat(tau)),
     xlab = expression(hat(tau)))
abline(v = tau_true, lty = 2)

boxplot(res$r1_hat_cp, res$r2_hat_cp,
        names = c(expression(hat(r)[1]), expression(hat(r)[2])),
        main = "Estimated growth rates")
abline(h = r1_true, lty = 2)
abline(h = r2_true, lty = 3)

# =========================================================
# 5. FIT ONE DATASET FOR BOOTSTRAP
# =========================================================

set.seed(999)

t <- 1:n

mu_true_one <- ifelse(
  t <= tau_true,
  K_true / (1 + exp(-r1_true * (t - t0_true))),
  K_true / (1 + exp(-r2_true * (t - t0_true)))
)

y_one <- mu_true_one + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma_true)

dat <- data.frame(
  t = t,
  y = y_one,
  mu_true = mu_true_one
)

fit_no_one <- fit_no_change_model(dat$t, dat$y)
fit_cp_one <- fit_change_point_model(dat$t, dat$y, candidate_tau)

if (is.null(fit_cp_one)) {
  stop("Change-point model failed on the bootstrap dataset.")
}

tau_hat <- fit_cp_one$tau_hat
par_cp  <- fit_cp_one$par
mu_hat_cp <- fit_cp_one$fitted

cat("\n================ ONE-DATASET FIT ================\n")
cat("Estimated tau:", tau_hat, "\n")
print(par_cp)

# Plot one dataset fit
plot(dat$t, dat$y, pch = 16,
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Observed response",
     main = "One dataset: true mean and fitted change-point model")
lines(dat$t, dat$mu_true, lwd = 2, lty = 2)
lines(dat$t, mu_hat_cp, lwd = 2)
abline(v = tau_true, lty = 2)
abline(v = tau_hat, lty = 3)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("Observed data", "True mean", "Fitted CP mean",
                  "True tau", "Estimated tau"),
       pch = c(16, NA, NA, NA, NA),
       lty = c(NA, 2, 1, 2, 3),
       lwd = c(NA, 2, 2, 1, 1),
       bty = "n")

# Profile plot for one dataset
plot(fit_cp_one$profile$tau, fit_cp_one$profile$nll,
     type = "b", pch = 16,
     xlab = expression(tau),
     ylab = "Negative log-likelihood",
     main = "Profile over candidate change-points")
abline(v = tau_true, lty = 2)
abline(v = tau_hat, lty = 3)

# =========================================================
# 6. PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP FOR ONE FITTED DATASET
# =========================================================

set.seed(456)

B <- 200

boot_results <- data.frame(
  b = 1:B,
  tau_hat = NA_real_,
  K_hat = NA_real_,
  r1_hat = NA_real_,
  r2_hat = NA_real_,
  t0_hat = NA_real_,
  sigma_hat = NA_real_
)

mu_fitted <- logistic_mean_cp(
  t = dat$t,
  K = par_cp["K"],
  r1 = par_cp["r1"],
  r2 = par_cp["r2"],
  t0 = par_cp["t0"],
  tau = tau_hat
)

sigma_fitted <- par_cp["sigma"]

for (b in 1:B) {
  y_boot <- mu_fitted + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma_fitted)
  
  fit_boot <- fit_change_point_model(dat$t, y_boot, candidate_tau)
  
  if (!is.null(fit_boot)) {
    boot_results$tau_hat[b]   <- fit_boot$tau_hat
    boot_results$K_hat[b]     <- fit_boot$par["K"]
    boot_results$r1_hat[b]    <- fit_boot$par["r1"]
    boot_results$r2_hat[b]    <- fit_boot$par["r2"]
    boot_results$t0_hat[b]    <- fit_boot$par["t0"]
    boot_results$sigma_hat[b] <- fit_boot$par["sigma"]
  }
  
  if (b %% 20 == 0) {
    cat("Finished bootstrap", b, "of", B, "\n")
  }
}

boot_valid <- boot_results[complete.cases(boot_results), ]

boot_ci <- function(x) {
  quantile(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
}

ci_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("tau", "K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma"),
  Lower = c(
    boot_ci(boot_valid$tau_hat)[1],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$K_hat)[1],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$r1_hat)[1],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$r2_hat)[1],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$t0_hat)[1],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$sigma_hat)[1]
  ),
  Upper = c(
    boot_ci(boot_valid$tau_hat)[2],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$K_hat)[2],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$r1_hat)[2],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$r2_hat)[2],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$t0_hat)[2],
    boot_ci(boot_valid$sigma_hat)[2]
  )
)

cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP 95% CIs ================\n")
print(ci_table)

# Bootstrap plots
hist(boot_valid$tau_hat,
     breaks = 20,
     main = expression("Bootstrap of " * hat(tau)),
     xlab = expression(hat(tau)))
abline(v = tau_hat, lty = 2)

boxplot(boot_valid$r1_hat, boot_valid$r2_hat,
        names = c(expression(hat(r)[1]), expression(hat(r)[2])),
        main = "Bootstrap distributions of growth rates")

# =========================================================
# 7. OPTIONAL: SAVE OUTPUTS
# =========================================================
# saveRDS(sim_results, "simulation_results_logistic_cp.rds")
# saveRDS(boot_results, "bootstrap_results_logistic_cp.rds")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SECTION: BAYESIAN INFERENCE VIA METROPOLIS-WITHIN-GIBBS
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# LOG-PRIOR: returns 0 if all params in bounds, -Inf if not
# This encodes Uniform priors on each parameter
# ---------------------------------------------------------
log_prior <- function(K, r1, r2, t0, sigma, tau) {
  if (K     < 50    || K     > 300)  return(-Inf)
  if (r1    < 0.001 || r1    > 2)    return(-Inf)
  if (r2    < 0.001 || r2    > 2)    return(-Inf)
  if (t0    < 1     || t0    > 60)   return(-Inf)
  if (sigma < 0.1   || sigma > 20)   return(-Inf)
  if (!(tau %in% candidate_tau))     return(-Inf)
  return(0)  # log(1) = 0 for uniform prior within bounds
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# LOG-LIKELIHOOD: Gaussian log-likelihood for CP model
# ---------------------------------------------------------
log_likelihood_cp <- function(K, r1, r2, t0, sigma, tau, t, y) {
  mu <- logistic_mean_cp(t, K, r1, r2, t0, tau)
  sum(dnorm(y, mean = mu, sd = sigma, log = TRUE))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# LOG-POSTERIOR: log-prior + log-likelihood
# ---------------------------------------------------------
log_posterior <- function(K, r1, r2, t0, sigma, tau, t, y) {
  lp <- log_prior(K, r1, r2, t0, sigma, tau)
  if (!is.finite(lp)) return(-Inf)  # reject immediately if out of bounds
  lp + log_likelihood_cp(K, r1, r2, t0, sigma, tau, t, y)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# METROPOLIS-WITHIN-GIBBS SAMPLER
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Arguments:
#   y, t        : data
#   init        : named list of starting values
#   n_iter      : total number of MCMC iterations
#   proposal_sd : named list of proposal standard deviations
#                 (tuning parameters - controls step size)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

run_mcmc <- function(y, t, init, n_iter = 12000,
                     proposal_sd = list(K=3, r1=0.01, r2=0.01,
                                        t0=0.5, sigma=0.2)) {
  
  # Storage matrix: rows = iterations, cols = parameters
  chain <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_iter, ncol = 6)
  colnames(chain) <- c("K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma", "tau")
  
  # Initialize
  K_cur     <- init$K
  r1_cur    <- init$r1
  r2_cur    <- init$r2
  t0_cur    <- init$t0
  sigma_cur <- init$sigma
  tau_cur   <- init$tau
  
  # Current log-posterior
  lp_cur <- log_posterior(K_cur, r1_cur, r2_cur, t0_cur,
                          sigma_cur, tau_cur, t, y)
  
  # Track acceptance counts for diagnostics
  accept_count <- rep(0, 6)
  names(accept_count) <- c("K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma", "tau")
  
  cat("Starting MCMC...\n")
  
  for (i in 1:n_iter) {
    
    # ---- Update K ----
    K_prop <- K_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$K)
    lp_prop <- log_posterior(K_prop, r1_cur, r2_cur, t0_cur,
                             sigma_cur, tau_cur, t, y)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      K_cur  <- K_prop
      lp_cur <- lp_prop
      accept_count["K"] <- accept_count["K"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update r1 ----
    r1_prop <- r1_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$r1)
    lp_prop <- log_posterior(K_cur, r1_prop, r2_cur, t0_cur,
                             sigma_cur, tau_cur, t, y)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      r1_cur <- r1_prop
      lp_cur <- lp_prop
      accept_count["r1"] <- accept_count["r1"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update r2 ----
    r2_prop <- r2_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$r2)
    lp_prop <- log_posterior(K_cur, r1_cur, r2_prop, t0_cur,
                             sigma_cur, tau_cur, t, y)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      r2_cur <- r2_prop
      lp_cur <- lp_prop
      accept_count["r2"] <- accept_count["r2"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update t0 ----
    t0_prop <- t0_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$t0)
    lp_prop <- log_posterior(K_cur, r1_cur, r2_cur, t0_prop,
                             sigma_cur, tau_cur, t, y)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      t0_cur <- t0_prop
      lp_cur <- lp_prop
      accept_count["t0"] <- accept_count["t0"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update sigma ----
    sigma_prop <- sigma_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$sigma)
    lp_prop <- log_posterior(K_cur, r1_cur, r2_cur, t0_cur,
                             sigma_prop, tau_cur, t, y)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      sigma_cur <- sigma_prop
      lp_cur    <- lp_prop
      accept_count["sigma"] <- accept_count["sigma"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update tau (discrete) ----
    # Propose a jump of -2, -1, +1, or +2 with equal probability
    jump     <- sample(c(-2, -1, 1, 2), size = 1)
    tau_prop <- tau_cur + jump
    lp_prop  <- log_posterior(K_cur, r1_cur, r2_cur, t0_cur,
                              sigma_cur, tau_prop, t, y)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      tau_cur <- tau_prop
      lp_cur  <- lp_prop
      accept_count["tau"] <- accept_count["tau"] + 1
    }
    
    # Store current state
    chain[i, ] <- c(K_cur, r1_cur, r2_cur, t0_cur, sigma_cur, tau_cur)
    
    # Progress update
    if (i %% 2000 == 0) cat("  Iteration", i, "of", n_iter, "\n")
  }
  
  cat("Done.\n\n")
  cat("Acceptance rates:\n")
  print(round(accept_count / n_iter, 3))
  
  list(chain = chain, accept_rate = accept_count / n_iter)
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# RUN MCMC ON THE ONE FITTED DATASET (dat$t, dat$y)
# Use MLE estimates as starting values - this is good practice
# as it starts the chain near the posterior mode
# ---------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(2024)

init_vals <- list(
  K     = as.numeric(par_cp["K"]),
  r1    = as.numeric(par_cp["r1"]),
  r2    = as.numeric(par_cp["r2"]),
  t0    = as.numeric(par_cp["t0"]),
  sigma = as.numeric(par_cp["sigma"]),
  tau   = tau_hat
)

# --------------------------------------------------------
# RERUN with longer chain + thinning
# Run 50,000 iterations, discard 5000 burnin, thin by 10
# Final result: ~4500 nearly independent samples
# --------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2024)

mcmc_long <- run_mcmc(
  y           = dat$y,
  t           = dat$t,
  init        = init_vals,
  n_iter      = 50000,
  proposal_sd = list(
    K     = 4,
    r1    = 0.025,
    r2    = 0.008,
    t0    = 1.0,
    sigma = 0.8
  )
)

# Burnin + thinning
burnin_long  <- 5000
thin_by      <- 10
raw_post     <- mcmc_long$chain[(burnin_long + 1):50000, ]
thin_idx     <- seq(1, nrow(raw_post), by = thin_by)
chain_post   <- raw_post[thin_idx, ]   # overwrites chain_post

cat("Acceptance rates:\n")
print(round(mcmc_long$accept_rate, 3))
cat("\nSamples after burnin + thinning:", nrow(chain_post), "\n")

# ESS check
ess_final <- effectiveSize(chain_post)
cat("\n==== ESS AFTER THINNING ====\n")
print(round(ess_final, 0))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# TRACE PLOTS - most important diagnostic
# A good chain looks like "fuzzy caterpillar" - no trends,
# no getting stuck, mixing well around a stable mean
# ---------------------------------------------------------

par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

param_names  <- c("K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma", "tau")
true_vals    <- c(K_true, r1_true, r2_true, t0_true, sigma_true, tau_true)
param_labels <- c("K", expression(r[1]), expression(r[2]),
                  expression(t[0]), expression(sigma), expression(tau))

for (j in 1:6) {
  plot(chain_post[, j],
       type = "l",
       col  = "steelblue",
       xlab = "Post-burnin iteration",
       ylab = param_labels[[j]],
       main = paste("Trace:", param_names[j]))
  abline(h = true_vals[j], col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# AUTOCORRELATION PLOTS
# Low autocorrelation = chain is mixing well (efficient)
# High autocorrelation = chain moves slowly, may need more
# iterations or larger proposal steps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
library(coda)
ess_vals <- effectiveSize(chain_post)
cat("\n================ EFFECTIVE SAMPLE SIZE ================\n")
print(round(ess_vals, 0))

par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (j in 1:6) {
  acf(chain_post[, j],
      main = paste("ACF:", param_names[j]),
      col  = "steelblue",
      lag.max = 50)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# POSTERIOR SUMMARY TABLE (fixed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
post_mean   <- apply(chain_post, 2, mean)
post_median <- apply(chain_post, 2, median)
post_lower  <- apply(chain_post, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
post_upper  <- apply(chain_post, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)

posterior_summary <- data.frame(
  Parameter   = param_names,
  True_Value  = true_vals,
  Post_Mean   = as.numeric(post_mean),
  Post_Median = as.numeric(post_median),
  Lower_95    = as.numeric(post_lower),
  Upper_95    = as.numeric(post_upper)
)



# ---------------------------------------------------------
# POSTERIOR DENSITY PLOTS with true value marked
# ---------------------------------------------------------

par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (j in 1:6) {
  
  # tau is discrete - use a bar plot instead of density
  if (param_names[j] == "tau") {
    tau_table <- table(chain_post[, j])
    barplot(tau_table / sum(tau_table),
            main = expression("Posterior of " * tau),
            xlab = expression(tau),
            ylab = "Probability",
            col  = "steelblue",
            border = "white")
    abline(v = which(names(tau_table) == as.character(tau_true)) - 0.5,
           col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  } else {
    d <- density(chain_post[, j])
    plot(d,
         main = paste("Posterior:", param_names[j]),
         xlab = param_labels[[j]],
         col  = "steelblue",
         lwd  = 2)
    # Shade 95% credible interval
    ci_lo <- quantile(chain_post[, j], 0.025)
    ci_hi <- quantile(chain_post[, j], 0.975)
    x_shade <- d$x[d$x >= ci_lo & d$x <= ci_hi]
    y_shade <- d$y[d$x >= ci_lo & d$x <= ci_hi]
    polygon(c(x_shade, rev(x_shade)),
            c(y_shade, rep(0, length(y_shade))),
            col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.3),
            border = NA)
    abline(v = true_vals[j], col = "red",    lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    abline(v = mean(chain_post[, j]), col = "darkblue", lty = 1, lwd = 1)
    legend("topright",
           legend = c("True value", "Posterior mean", "95% CI"),
           col    = c("red", "darkblue", "steelblue"),
           lty    = c(2, 1, NA),
           fill   = c(NA, NA, adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3)),
           border = c(NA, NA, NA),
           bty    = "n", cex = 0.8)
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# COMPARISON TABLE: Bootstrap CI vs Posterior Credible Interval (fixed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

boot_lower <- as.numeric(c(
  quantile(boot_valid$tau_hat,   0.025),
  quantile(boot_valid$K_hat,     0.025),
  quantile(boot_valid$r1_hat,    0.025),
  quantile(boot_valid$r2_hat,    0.025),
  quantile(boot_valid$t0_hat,    0.025),
  quantile(boot_valid$sigma_hat, 0.025)
))

boot_upper <- as.numeric(c(
  quantile(boot_valid$tau_hat,   0.975),
  quantile(boot_valid$K_hat,     0.975),
  quantile(boot_valid$r1_hat,    0.975),
  quantile(boot_valid$r2_hat,    0.975),
  quantile(boot_valid$t0_hat,    0.975),
  quantile(boot_valid$sigma_hat, 0.975)
))

bayes_lower <- as.numeric(c(
  quantile(chain_post[, "tau"],   0.025),
  quantile(chain_post[, "K"],     0.025),
  quantile(chain_post[, "r1"],    0.025),
  quantile(chain_post[, "r2"],    0.025),
  quantile(chain_post[, "t0"],    0.025),
  quantile(chain_post[, "sigma"], 0.025)
))

bayes_upper <- as.numeric(c(
  quantile(chain_post[, "tau"],   0.975),
  quantile(chain_post[, "K"],     0.975),
  quantile(chain_post[, "r1"],    0.975),
  quantile(chain_post[, "r2"],    0.975),
  quantile(chain_post[, "t0"],    0.975),
  quantile(chain_post[, "sigma"], 0.975)
))

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter   = c("tau", "K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma"),
  Boot_Lower  = boot_lower,
  Boot_Upper  = boot_upper,
  Bayes_Lower = bayes_lower,
  Bayes_Upper = bayes_upper
)

# Print comparison table without round() on the whole frame
cat("\n===== BOOTSTRAP vs BAYESIAN CREDIBLE INTERVALS =====\n")
comparison_table[, -1] <- round(comparison_table[, -1], 4)
print(comparison_table)
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------
# CI COMPARISON PLOT — displays in RStudio plot panel
# --------------------------------------------------------

par(mar = c(5, 5, 3, 2))

params_plot <- c("K", "r1", "r2", "t0", "sigma")
true_plot   <- c(K_true, r1_true, r2_true, t0_true, sigma_true)

boot_lo <- c(quantile(boot_valid$K_hat,     0.025),
             quantile(boot_valid$r1_hat,    0.025),
             quantile(boot_valid$r2_hat,    0.025),
             quantile(boot_valid$t0_hat,    0.025),
             quantile(boot_valid$sigma_hat, 0.025))

boot_hi <- c(quantile(boot_valid$K_hat,     0.975),
             quantile(boot_valid$r1_hat,    0.975),
             quantile(boot_valid$r2_hat,    0.975),
             quantile(boot_valid$t0_hat,    0.975),
             quantile(boot_valid$sigma_hat, 0.975))

bayes_lo <- as.numeric(apply(chain_post[, c("K","r1","r2","t0","sigma")],
                              2, quantile, 0.025))
bayes_hi <- as.numeric(apply(chain_post[, c("K","r1","r2","t0","sigma")],
                              2, quantile, 0.975))

boot_lo_sc  <- (boot_lo  - true_plot) / true_plot * 100
boot_hi_sc  <- (boot_hi  - true_plot) / true_plot * 100
bayes_lo_sc <- (bayes_lo - true_plot) / true_plot * 100
bayes_hi_sc <- (bayes_hi - true_plot) / true_plot * 100

plot(NULL, xlim = c(0.5, 5.5), ylim = c(-60, 60),
     xaxt = "n", xlab = "Parameter",
     ylab = "% deviation from true value",
     main = "Bootstrap CI vs Bayesian Credible Interval")
axis(1, at = 1:5,
     labels = c("K", expression(r[1]), expression(r[2]),
                expression(t[0]), expression(sigma)))
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
abline(h = seq(-60, 60, 20), lty = 3, col = "gray85", lwd = 0.8)

for (j in 1:5) {
  lines(c(j - 0.15, j - 0.15), c(boot_lo_sc[j],  boot_hi_sc[j]),
        lwd = 4, col = "steelblue")
  points(j - 0.15, (boot_lo_sc[j] + boot_hi_sc[j]) / 2,
         pch = 19, cex = 1.2, col = "steelblue")
  lines(c(j + 0.15, j + 0.15), c(bayes_lo_sc[j], bayes_hi_sc[j]),
        lwd = 4, col = "darkorange")
  points(j + 0.15, (bayes_lo_sc[j] + bayes_hi_sc[j]) / 2,
         pch = 19, cex = 1.2, col = "darkorange")
}

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Bootstrap 95% CI", "Bayesian 95% CI", "True value"),
       col    = c("steelblue", "darkorange", "red"),
       lty    = c(1, 1, 2), lwd = c(3, 3, 2),
       pch    = c(19, 19, NA), bty = "n")
```
